sections.h2: Knells Ridge Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 54 residential sales closed in Knells Ridge (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $290,000, below the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 16 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Knells Ridge sales closed between $243,500 and $395,000, or about $199 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($315,000, 24 sales) was about 18% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($267,450, 30 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Knells Ridge sales were in ZIP code 23320.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Knells Ridge
sections.html:
44% of the sales were detached homes and 56% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,437 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,254 to 1,704 square feet. 41% of the homes that sold had 2 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1987 and 1995, with a median year built of 1989, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
